classification_categories.power_calc: Formal a priori power calculation (α, β, effect size specified)
classification_categories.effect_size_estimate: Quantitative estimate from pilot/literature, no formal calc
classification_categories.replication_standard: Appeal to field convention or replication of prior study
classification_categories.resource_constraint: Sample size limited by availability, budget, or cohort size
classification_categories.methodology_determined: Sample size inherently defined by measurement technique or study design (stereology, cryo-EM, single-molecule imaging, complete-specimen census); no separate determination step expected
classification_categories.no_justification: n stated but no reasoning provided
classification_categories.na_or_blank: Field empty, N/A, or not applicable
classification_categories.ambiguous: Text present but insufficient to classify

records.title: The ubiquitin ligase KLHL6 drives resistance to CD8+ T cell dysfunction
records.sample_size_raw: The sample size for each experiment is indicated in the figures and figure legends. Sample sizes were based on our experience and common practice in the related fields, balancing statistic robustness, resource availability and animal welfare. No Statistical methods were used to predetermine sample size. For in vitro experiments, at least three independent sample were achieved. n= 3 samples were used for RNA-seq and protein MS analysis. n=40-60 cells were used for statistics of mitochondrial area and crista length. For in vivo experiments, n = 5-14 mice were used per experimental group.

records.title: N1-Methylpseudouridine directly modulates translation dynamics
records.sample_size_raw: Sample sizes were determined based on prior experience with each assay, and practical constraints. No formal a priori power calculations were performed. Ribosome profiling experiments were performed with 2 biological replicates due to the requirement to process samples in parallel to avoid batch effects. Luciferase assays and GFP flow cytometry experiments were conducted with 23 biological replicates to allow statistical comparison. Immunoprecipitation (IP) experiments were performed with 3-4 biological replicates, depending on feasibility. All “n” values refer to biological replicates (independent experiments), with technical replicates averaged prior to analysis.

records.title: Predictive coding of reward in the hippocampus
records.sample_size_raw: Eight naive male mice were trained and recorded for weeks. In average we recorded 504 + 101 (mean + std) neurons across session and mice. For analyzing backward shifting reward cells we could reliably track 194 reward cells across mice.

records.title: Pyramidal neurons proportionately alter cortical interneuron subtypes
records.sample_size_raw: Sample sizes were not predetermined using a formal statistical power analysis. Instead, sample sizes were chosen based on established practices in the field to ensure the robust and reproducible detection of biological effects, while adhering to the principles of the 3Rs (Replacement, Reduction, and Refinement). For Slide-seq, in situ hybridization and related analyses, a minimum of n=3-5 biological replicates (individual mice) per experimental condition was used. For large-scale, resource-intensive experiments such as snRNA-seq and MERFISH, sample sizes were chosen based on the high dimensionality and information content of the data. The statistical power of these experiments is derived not only from the number of biological replicates but also from the high-throughput sampling of thousands of cells or nuclei. For all experiments, the specific n (representing biological replicates/mice) and, where relevant, the number of technical replicates (e.g., ROIs, sections, or nuclei) are explicitly stated in the figure legends and/or main text.
